en-US.longDescription: AutoText is a text expander (auto-typer) application that can minimize time that you spent typing phrases that your often use. You can bind an abbreviation(autotext) to some text snippet, phrase or sentence and that text will be automatically typed by AutoText each time you type the abbreviation. Keyboard keys press/hold/toggle is supported by using macros. AutoText works in any Windows program.
en-US.name: AutoText

zh-CN.description: 文本扩展（自动输入）工具
zh-CN.longDescription: AutoText 是一款文本扩展（自动输入）工具，可大幅减少您输入常用短语的时间。您可以将缩写（自动文本）绑定到某个文本片段、短语或句子，之后每次输入该缩写时，AutoText 就会自动输出完整内容。通过使用宏功能，还支持键盘按键的按下/长按/切换操作。本软件兼容所有 Windows 程序。
